description: KNaSO₄ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-3.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.81 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 19°. There is one shorter (1.46 Å) and three longer (1.51 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent K, two Na, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one K and one S atom.
